pieces.Text: A steelblood gains a +1 bonus on combat maneuver checks, to CMD against overrun combat maneuvers, and on Reflex saving throws against trample attacks. He also gains a +1 bonus to his AC against charge attacks and on attack and damage rolls against charging creatures.
+1 to AC against charge attacks and on attack and damage rolls against charging creatures.
+1 on Reflex saving throws against trample attacks.
